data.one_liner: A simple package to generate acronyms from strings with support for stop words and syllables.
data.what_it_does: Generates acronyms from input text using a function or a string extension. It allows filtering out stop words and splitting words into syllables to form the acronym.
use_when: You need to generate acronyms from user names, titles, or phrases in your app.
You want to customize acronym generation by excluding stop words or utilizing syllables.
avoid_when: You need complex text processing or NLP capabilities beyond acronym generation.
You require extensive localized stop word dictionaries out of the box.
strengths: Provides both a function and a convenient string extension
Supports custom stop words and syllable splitting
weaknesses: Very narrow scope focused solely on acronyms
